description: 66-15348 lies in the FY66 AH-1G allocation; airframes in that block were routinely remanufactured through AH-1S to AH-1F so the F suffix is credible but not independently confirmed; displayed at the post on DuBois Street in Sandy Township; present in OpenStreetMap 28 July 2026 as node 11146813432 tagged historic=aircraft at the Aerial Visuals coordinates. Presence confirmed in current aerial imagery showing the helicopter on its pedestal.
